name: Stone Body Mutagen (Lesser)
effects: For 10 minutes: resistance 5 to physical damage except bludgeoning; all Speeds reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet); −2 penalty to Reflex saves.

name: Stone Body Mutagen (Moderate)
effects: For 1 hour: resistance 5 to physical damage except bludgeoning; all Speeds reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet); −2 penalty to Reflex saves.

name: Storm Breath
effects: While the breath is held: resistance 5 to electricity and resistance 5 to sonic damage.

name: Sun Slayer
effects: While this shield is Raised, you gain resistance 5 to fire damage.

name: Swarmsuit
effects: While wearing the swarmsuit and fighting swarms: resistance 3 to physical damage from swarms.

name: Tallowheart Mass
effects: For 1 minute after rubbing a portion on your body: resistance 10 to fire damage. (Separate portions instead grant quickened 1 for 1 minute usable only for held-weapon Strikes, or heal 4d8+12 — the mass has three portions total.)

name: Thorn of Milani (Lesser)
effects: Until the end of your next turn after activating the thorn: weakness 1 to unholy. The triggering Strike also deals an extra 1d4 spirit damage with the holy trait.

name: Thorn Triad
toggleName: Thorn Triad — Armor (after a plant spell)
effects: Until the end of your next turn after casting a plant spell by activating the triad: resistance 2 to bludgeoning and piercing damage (4 if the spell was not a cantrip) and weakness 3 to fire.

name: Thorn Triad (Greater)
toggleName: Thorn Triad (Greater) — Armor (after a plant spell)
effects: Until the end of your next turn after casting a plant spell by activating the triad: resistance 4 to bludgeoning and piercing damage (8 if the spell was not a cantrip) and weakness 3 to fire.

name: Thorn Triad (Major)
toggleName: Thorn Triad (Major) — Armor (after a plant spell)
effects: Until the end of your next turn after casting a plant spell by activating the triad: resistance 6 to bludgeoning and piercing damage (12 if the spell was not a cantrip) and weakness 3 to fire.

name: Thousand-Year Dragonroot
effects: For 1 minute: gain a fly Speed of 40 feet and resistance 5 to fire damage; your body sheds light as a torch.

name: Tremorsensors
effects: While active (10 minutes, once per day): you gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 20 feet. No numeric modifiers; the granted sense is carried as the mode note, exactly like item-pallesthetic-mutagen's tremorsense/echolocation note.

name: Vengeful Remnant
effects: While active (until the start of your next turn, or the end of your next turn if you slay a significant foe with the Spectral Dagger): resistance 10 to all damage except force, ghost touch, spirit and vitality; resistance 20 instead against non-magical damage.

name: Victory Plate
effects: For 1 minute: resistance 5 to one damage type chosen from the recorded creature's trait — mental (aberration/fey), good (celestial), poison (construct), a matching energy type (dragon/elemental), evil (fiend), void (undead), or precision at resistance 10 (ooze).

name: Warcaller's Chime of Resistance
effects: For 10 minutes (once per week): resistance 5 to one chosen damage type — acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.

name: Warming Parka
effects: For 1 minute (once per day, dismissable): resistance 3 to cold damage, and Perception drops by 2 (a -2 item penalty). The always-on environmental-cold reduction stays in the note — it is GM/environment adjudicated.

name: Witch's Finger
effects: For 1 hour: resistance 3 to cold damage. Note (8 hours): negates severe environmental cold damage and reduces extreme cold to severe.

name: Wyrm Spindle
effects: For 1 minute after casting a non-cantrip spell by Activating the spindle: resistance 5 to fire, force, mental and spirit. Note: the Weapon benefit instead grants a 2-action Dragon Breath (6d6, once before the end of your next turn).
